# Psalm 121 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 121:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Not he-will-allow to-slip your-foot; not will-slumber your-keeper.
- **LOGOS:** He will not let your foot be moved; he who keeps you will not slumber.
- **PNEUMA:** He won't let you stumble; your protector never dozes off.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
